h: Shabbos Nachamu Contains All Seven Consolations

p: This Shabbos is called Shabbos Nachamu.
that the seven haftaros of consolation
correspond to the seven lower attributes;
that is, from the side of Hashem Yisbarach;
and their order is from above to below;
corresponds to the attribute of Chesed,
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him.
And it says in the holy Zohar
'By day Hashem commands His kindness,' etc.;
the day in which all the days
and therefore he is called 'yomam,' by day."
what it says about the attribute of Chesed,
that it includes all seven attributes,
which is the attribute of Malchus
for it includes all the attributes
(as is written in the holy Zohar many times),
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
'And Hashem blessed Avraham with everything — bakol';
and Bakol was her name," etc.
"And the Torah of kindness is on her tongue";
And "Torah in order to teach it"
and one must learn from another;
that it is "bound and lying in the corner, etc.,
"That works for the Written Torah," etc.
about Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him:
"The Holy One, blessed is He, prepared for him
מְרַמֵּז רַק עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
alludes only to Torah she'b'al peh.
And it is the attribute of Malchus,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
and it is called Bas Sheva,
for it includes all seven attributes.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is what the holy Zohar cited above says:
in which all the days are included."
And likewise on the first day
of the seven days of Creation,
which correspond to the seven attributes,
the first light was created on it,
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
for the first light was hidden away
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
And it says in Bereishis Rabbah
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham."
is written after it is written
that is, he merited the attribute of "old"
and this shows that he merited
which is the crown of Malchus.
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, is called
in the holy Zohar (Balak, there; III 191b):
and likewise his attribute is Chesed,
And so we find with Shem son of Noach,
"And he was a kohen to God Most High";
is from the side of Chesed;
"and he was a kohen to God Most High"
for he merited the attribute of Atika,
"Blessed be Hashem, the God of Shem."
that the Holy One, blessed is He, does not
attach His Name to the tzaddikim
and the yetzer hara ceased from him;
so how did the Holy One, blessed is He, attach
His Name to Shem in his lifetime?
since it is written in the Torah,
for the Torah would not write
But because he merited the attribute of Elyon,
being already bound to the root,
that the Holy One, blessed is He, does not
lest the yetzer hara mislead them;
יִיחֵד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמוֹ עַל שֵׁם
Hashem Yisbarach attached His Name to Shem.

p: what is written in the Ohr HaChaim
on the pasuk "for on it He rested"):
that at the time of Creation
Hashem Yisbarach created in the world
the power to endure six days,
and on Shabbos He again bestows
in the measure that sustains it
the world has not lacked one
was a guarder of Shabbos, etc.;
there is a view in the Midrash Rabbah
He gave him the mitzvah of Shabbos";
that according to all views he kept Shabbos,
even if he was not commanded.
And likewise from Avraham Avinu on,
there was certainly no lack of
and there is a view among the Rishonim
that they left the category of Bnei Noach
and was forbidden to rest on Shabbos,
how could he have guarded Shabbos?
But according to what was said,
and refined in all the attributes,
through this he already had the power
as through a guarder of Shabbos.
only a semblance of Olam HaBa,
at the time Noach was warned,
Shem was already in the world,
and it is written of him,
"Blessed be Hashem, the God of Shem,"
he merited the attribute of Elyon,
to give rise to the six days.
"Blessed be Avram of God Most High," etc.
for Avram merited the attribute of Elyon,
and the priesthood was taken from Shem
to Hashem, God Most High," etc.;
for he merited the attribute of Atika;
and it is expounded about this
that the Holy One, blessed is He, gave him a taste
and this is as is written in the holy Zohar:
מַה שֶּׁאָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
what the holy Zohar cited above says:
the day in which all the days are included."
we read as the haftarah on this Shabbos
as is written in the holy Zohar
which correspond to the seven attributes.
And the main consolation is on Shabbos,
from its being written, "on the day that He gives rest," etc.,
